companyProfile.businessSummary: As a leading IT services, consulting, and business solutions provider, Tata Consultancy Services has been partnering with the world's largest businesses on their transformation journeys for 57 years. Its vision is to help clients become 'Perpetually Adaptive Enterprises' by using technologies like AI, data, and cloud to navigate an ever-changing world. A core part of its mission is to build long-term value for clients by helping them emerge as highly adaptive enterprises through every technology cycle. The company delivers a wide portfolio of services including application development, digital transformation, AI, cloud services, and cognitive business operations for global clients. The company's business strategy is rooted in customer-centricity, which drives it to deliver exceptional outcomes and build strong, lasting relationships with corporations worldwide. Its global operations are supported by a diverse and highly skilled workforce of over 607,000 associates from 152 nationalities, spread across 55 countries.

With a legacy of over 200 years, State Bank of India has solidified its position as the country's largest bank, playing a pivotal role in the nation's financial landscape. The bank's vision is to be the preferred choice for a transforming India, guiding the nation's financial progress and adapting to its evolving needs. It is committed to delivering dependable financial solutions, maintaining high governance standards, and nurturing lasting relationships with individuals, businesses, and the nation. Its largest operational segment is Retail Banking, which is supported by a massive network of 22,937 branches spanning across 17 circles in the country. The bank is at the forefront of India's digital banking revolution, leading with its flagship mobile app, YONO, to offer comprehensive financial and lifestyle solutions. Reflecting its robust growth and immense scale, the bank's balance sheet size impressively crossed ₹66 Lakh Crore as of March 2025.

As one of the world's leading integrated telecom providers, Airtel is shaping the digital future across 17 countries, connecting over half a billion people with its digital network. The company's core vision is to enrich the lives of its customers and aims to win them for life by providing an exceptional experience. It is built on a strong foundation of Digital Infrastructure, Digital Experience, and Digital Services to transform connectivity and deliver a brilliant customer experience. For individuals and families, the company brings people together with seamless high-speed connectivity bundled with a diverse selection of digital content and entertainment. For enterprises, it offers robust connectivity powered by terrestrial and global fiber networks, modern data centres, and customized digital solutions. As India's number one integrated communications service provider, its network covers over 97% of the nation's population, ensuring widespread connectivity.

HDFC Bank believes that modern banking is about more than managing money; it's about fulfilling aspirations and shaping the futures of its customers and communities. The institution's core purpose is to help every Indian make better money choices, for both today and for the future, fostering financial well-being nationwide. A key principle for the bank is 'Digital First, Customer Always,' focusing on making banking seamless, intuitive, and personal in an era of digital disruption. It serves customers at every stage of their financial journey, whether they are in major cities, semi-urban towns, or rural heartlands. Following its successful merger with HDFC Limited, the bank has become a stronger financial services entity, enhancing its ability to provide end-to-end financial solutions. With 9,455 strategically located branches, 51% of which are in semi-urban and rural areas, it broadens access for previously underserved markets.

ICICI Bank is India’s second-largest private sector bank, headquartered in Mumbai. It provides a comprehensive range of banking products and financial services to corporate and retail customers through a variety of delivery channels and specialized subsidiaries.

Larsen & Toubro is a professionally managed Indian multinational corporation dedicated to achieving complete customer satisfaction and improving value for its shareholders. The company's vision is to have an innovative, entrepreneurial, and empowered team that consistently generates value and meets global benchmarks. It actively promotes a culture defined by caring, trust, and continuous learning to meet the expectations of all its stakeholders and society. The company's journey is defined by excellence across a diversified portfolio that includes infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, and services. The company is advancing towards a sustainable future by embedding decarbonisation into its strategic roadmap across its various business verticals. Financially, the company shows robust health, with its order book reaching a record ₹5.79 lakh crore, marking a 22% increase.

A subsidiary of Bajaj Finserv, Bajaj Finance is one of India’s largest and most diversified Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs). 

Headquartered in Pune, it has evolved from a captive auto-financier into a fintech powerhouse offering consumer durables financing, SME lending, and wealth management.
Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) is the largest state-owned insurance group and investment company in India.

Established in 1985, Kotak is one of India's leading diversified and integrated financial services conglomerates, providing a wide range of financial solutions across India. Its primary goal is to make banking simple and understandable by truly catering to the needs of its customers and infusing simplicity into every transaction. The bank operates on the core principles of trust, good governance, and careful risk management practices to ensure sustainable growth for all stakeholders. It provides a wide spectrum of services to retail customers and small businesses including savings accounts, various loans, and credit cards backed by digital-first solutions. The group's 'One Kotak' strategy focuses on seamlessly meeting all financial needs of a customer by drawing upon the combined capabilities of all its businesses. As of March 31, 2024, Kotak is a massive ₹7.7 trillion institution with a market capitalization of ₹3.5 trillion.

Hindustan Unilever Limited (HUL) is India’s largest Fast-Moving Consumer Goods company, guided by the belief that 'What is good for India, is good for HUL'. The company is focused on unlocking a billion aspirations, not just for its consumers, but for every stakeholder across its entire value chain. This journey is guided by core values of Integrity, Respect, Responsibility, and Pioneering, which are the simplest statement of who they are and govern everything they do. It offers a wide portfolio of over 50 brands across 15 FMCG categories, with products designed to meet the diverse needs of Indian consumers across all lifestyles. Its strategy involves segmenting its portfolio into Core, Future Core, and Market Makers to prioritize resources and drive growth in new and premium segments. As a result of its strong market presence and diverse offerings, the company holds market leadership in more than 85% of the business categories it operates in.

Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited is India's largest Integrated Transport Utility, providing unmatched connectivity from its ports to the customer's location using advanced digital technology. The company is pursuing the transformative direction of becoming an Integrated Transport Utility, investing boldly in expansion, decarbonisation, and automation to strengthen its leadership. It leverages an extensive portfolio of ports, marine assets, and logistics services to deliver tech-enabled integrated transport solutions for customers. Its services include a diverse set of marine assets like tugs and dredgers, and a multimodal logistics ecosystem with trains, trucks, and warehousing. The company is advancing towards its goal of becoming the world's largest Port Operator by 2030, a key part of its global strategy. In fiscal year 2024-25, the company's ports managed 27% of India's total cargo and a significant 45.5% of its container cargo.

Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. is a global pharmaceutical company and the largest in India by market share, with a significant presence in over 100 countries. The company's core purpose is to enhance global healthcare standards by making high-quality medicines more accessible and improving patient care for millions of people worldwide. It employs a therapy-focused strategy, concentrating on chronic and complex disease areas to maintain relevance and impact across different healthcare systems. Its diverse product range includes specialty medicines, branded generics, generics, and active pharmaceutical ingredients, available in forms like tablets, injectables, and creams. This is all made possible by its 40 manufacturing facilities approved by leading global regulatory authorities and a dedicated workforce of over 43,000 employees. As the leading pharmaceutical company in India, 29 of its brands feature among the nation's top 300, reflecting its strong market position.

Starting its journey eight decades ago, the Mahindra Group has evolved into a global federation of companies, with Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd. as its flagship mobility and farm solutions entity. The group's core purpose is to drive positive change that helps communities rise, with a clear focus on leading in environmental and social governance. It offers an extensive lineup of vehicles, including authentic SUVs, sturdy pickups, and light commercial vehicles, alongside a dominant position in the tractor segment. The company has expanded its portfolio to include electric vehicles, two-wheelers, power generators, and construction equipment to cater to a changing audience. Mahindra & Mahindra is recognized as India's number one SUV company by revenue market share and the number one Electric 3-Wheeler company.

Established in 1984 as a joint venture between the Tata Group and TIDCO, Titan has grown into a prominent name in the integrated lifestyle sector. Its core vision is to create elevating experiences for the people it touches and to make a significant impact on the world. The company pursues its goals through a pioneering spirit and a caring, value-driven culture that fosters innovation and high performance. Titan has built a strong and diverse portfolio of iconic brands in Jewellery, Watches & Wearables, EyeCare, Fragrances & Women's Bags, and Indian Dresswear. Under its 'Pragati' vision, the company combines care for the planet, inclusive growth, and transparent, ethical governance in its long-term strategy. The company has a vast footprint with over 3,312 stores, a retail area of 47 lakh square feet, and 11 manufacturing facilities.

Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting, serving clients in over 59 countries with AI, cloud, and digital solutions. The company's purpose is to amplify human potential, creating new opportunities for people, businesses, and communities through technology. A core principle is to consistently surpass client expectations, a value encapsulated as 'Client value'. The company provides clients with an AI-first foundation, empowering their business with scalable enterprise AI and other digital technologies. Its always-on learning approach drives continuous improvement by building and transferring skills from its innovation ecosystem. During fiscal 2025, the company engaged with 1,869 active clients globally, highlighting its extensive and robust client base.

Adani Enterprises Limited (AEL) is the flagship company of the Adani Portfolio and India's largest listed business incubator, concentrating on creating new businesses vital to national growth. Its vision is to become a world-class leader in businesses that enrich lives and help build national infrastructure through sustainable value creation. AEL has a successful history of incubating assets crucial to India's development and then demerging them into separate, publicly listed companies. The company's incubation model is designed to support new businesses from their initial development phase until they can operate independently. Current investments are focused on new infrastructure and utility segments such as green hydrogen, data centers, airports, and roads. The success of this model is shown by its incubating businesses contributing 60% of the total EBITDA, making them the primary performance driver in FY 2024-25.

Adani Power Limited is the largest private-sector thermal power producer in India and a core pillar of the Adani Group’s energy vertical. With a current operational capacity of 17.5 GW and an ambitious roadmap to reach 30.6 GW by 2030, the company is a critical contributor to India’s energy security.

Maruti Suzuki India was founded with the vision to put the nation on wheels by providing the 'Joy of Mobility' and is now a leader in the Indian automobile industry. The company is committed to partnering in India's journey to become a developed nation, known as Viksit Bharat, by the year 2047. Its working principle of creating shared value has helped propel India to become the 3rd largest car market in the world, benefiting numerous sections of society. To reduce its carbon footprint, it is developing multiple powertrain technologies including Battery Electric Vehicles (BEVs), Hybrids, and Biofuels like Ethanol and Compressed Biogas. With exports being a key growth driver, the company has ambitious plans to scale up its annual production capacity to approximately 4 million units by FY 2030-31. In the financial year 2023-24, the company achieved its highest-ever total sales, crossing the major milestone of 2 million units for the first time.

Axis Bank is India's third-largest private sector bank, providing a complete suite of banking products and financial services covering retail, wholesale, and treasury operations. Its guiding vision is to be the preferred financial services provider, excelling in customer service delivery through insightful employees and the smart application of modern technology. Core values of Customer Centricity, Ethics, Ownership, Transparency, and Teamwork shape every interaction and decision the company makes across its operations. The bank's 'Growth, Profitability, and Sustainability' (GPS) strategy focuses on accelerating deposit growth, achieving leadership in key market segments, and ensuring robust corporate governance. Operations are supported by a vast domestic network of 5,879 locations and a strong 'Bharat Banking' franchise to serve rural and semi-urban India. Demonstrating its ESG commitment, the bank exceeded its sustainable wholesale lending target of ₹30,000 crores well ahead of the 2026 deadline, achieving ₹48,412 crores by 2025.

As a global technology company, HCLTech combines top-tier technology and skilled professionals to help international businesses speed up their digital transformation journeys. The company's core purpose is to unite the best of technology and its people to supercharge progress for clients, employees, communities, and the planet. It cultivates a culture of 'Ideapreneurship' through a grassroots innovation portal, which generated over 17,000 ideas and delivered $1.4 billion in customer value in FY24. Its offerings include Digital Business, Digital Foundation, and Digital Process Operations, helping clients to unlock value across every step of their journey using digital technology and AI. Additionally, the HCLSoftware division offers a wide range of software products in areas like Data and Analytics, Security, and Compliance to serve specialized client needs. This global operation is supported by a vibrant community of over 227,000 employees from 159 nationalities working across 60 countries, ensuring a strong base for growth.

Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) is a key government-owned company in India's Aerospace & Defence industry, focused on supporting the country's defence needs. The company’s overarching vision is to secure a position as a global leader in the Aerospace & Defence sector through continuous innovation and excellence. Its mission is to deliver high-quality technology solutions to customers by leveraging its advanced infrastructure and skills in design, manufacturing, and services. HAL produces new aircraft and helicopters, including Light Combat Aircraft (LCA) Tejas, Dornier Do-228, and the Advanced Light Helicopter (ALH) Dhruv across its divisions. The company actively supports the 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' initiative, focusing on designing and developing indigenous products to meet future defence and aerospace requirements. The company's strong market position is reflected in its healthy order book, which stood at over ₹94,129 Crore as of March 2024.

Eternal Limited is a multinational technology conglomerate based in Gurugram, India. It serves as the parent entity for four primary businesses: Zomato (Food delivery and dining), Blinkit (Quick commerce), Hyperpure (B2B supply), and District (Going-out and lifestyle services).

The company has evolved from a food-tech pioneer into a global "commerce ecosystem" powerhouse. Post the leadership transitions, Eternal is currently focused on vertical integration and AI-driven operational efficiency.

ITC Limited is one of India's foremost private sector enterprises, operating across agriculture, manufacturing, and services to contribute significantly to the national economy. The company's core vision is to create substantial societal value through a model of 'Responsible Competitiveness,' ensuring business growth also benefits society and the environment. Guided by its 'Nation First' credo, ITC is committed to empowering farmers, building world-class Indian brands, and tackling challenges like climate change and livelihood generation. Its main businesses include Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) with over 25 world-class brands, a pioneering hotel chain, and leadership in Paperboards and Agri Business. Through its 'ITC Next' strategy, the company is building future-ready businesses by focusing on digital technology, sustainability, and consumer-centric innovation to drive growth. A global leader in sustainability, it is the only enterprise of its kind in the world to be water, carbon, and solid waste recycling positive for over a decade.

UltraTech Cement is the primary cement company of the Aditya Birla Group and a powerhouse in building solutions with a value of $8.4 billion. Its main vision is to establish itself as the foremost leader in providing comprehensive building solutions to its customers across the board. The company's mission is founded on four key principles, including sustainability, innovation, team empowerment, and a strong focus on customer needs. Over the years, it has evolved from being just a cement maker into a complete provider of building materials and services. The business operates an extensive distribution network to ensure that its products and services are reliably delivered to projects throughout the country. Highlighting its vast production scale, the company manufactures 2.4 billion bags of cement every single year for the market.

JSW Steel is one of India's leading integrated and geographically diverse steel manufacturers, committed to partnering in the nation's growth story and fostering progress. Its core purpose is to build world-class infrastructure, products, and solutions, while also deploying world-class capabilities and nurturing its communities. The company adopts advanced technologies to ensure steel remains a preferred material, transitioning towards a low-carbon future and reducing its environmental footprint. It produces a wide range of steel products that are vital for large-scale infrastructure, including hot-rolled, cold-rolled, coated, and electrical steel products. A key part of its strategy is achieving cost leadership through resource optimisation and has enhanced its raw material security with 24 captive iron ore mines. The company plans to significantly expand its capacity to 50 MTPA in India by the end of the decade to meet the country's accelerating steel demand.

Operating for over a decade, Mohini has established a strong presence in the healthcare products sector, aiming to make quality healthcare accessible and affordable for all. The company’s vision is to build a globally recognized brand known for its innovative, high-quality, and customer-focused products and services in the health and hygiene market. Its primary goal is to continuously innovate, evolve its offerings, and enhance product quality and the overall customer experience with every step it takes forward. It manufactures a wide variety of items, including essential medical supplies like surgical cotton, cotton balls, zig-zag cotton, and versatile gamjee rolls for different needs. Mohini uses a strategic network of dealers spread all across India to efficiently sell and distribute its medical consumable products throughout the entire country. The company showcases its large-scale production by manufacturing 10,800 tonnes of bleached cotton and 2,400 tonnes of surgical cotton products every year.

Divi's Laboratories is a prominent global manufacturer specializing in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Custom Synthesis for innovator companies, and high-quality Nutraceutical ingredients. The company's vision is to create lasting value for its stakeholders by producing superior generic APIs and custom intermediates for the global pharmaceutical and nutraceutical industries. It aims to be a responsible business, adding value through its expertise in chemistry and serving the community with diverse social initiatives for a better future. As an API-exclusive manufacturer, Divi's focuses solely on producing ingredients and does not compete with its customers by marketing the final medicine formulations. A key operational strength is its backward-integrated model, which allows the company to produce most key starting materials internally, ensuring quality and supply security. This business model has made Divi's a trusted global supplier to pharmaceutical companies across more than 100 countries, with exports making up 88% of its revenue.

Bajaj Finserv Limited is one of India's largest diversified financial services groups, serving as a financial lifecycle partner to the country's mass-affluent and middle-income population. The company's vision is to be a diversified yet integrated financial services entity with a pan-India presence, offering lifecycle financial solutions for its various customers. Its core strategy is to continuously integrate its various companies, both directly and digitally, to enhance the customer experience and create a larger collective value. It has placed significant emphasis on financial inclusion and innovation, leveraging new-age technologies to reach underserved locations and consumer segments. Through its 'Bajaj Beyond' initiative, the group has committed ₹5,000 crore to positively impact over two crore Indians over five years, focusing on skilling. On a consolidated basis, the company posted an all-time high financial performance, with a consolidated profit after tax of ₹8,872 crore.
Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) is India's largest crude oil and natural gas company, engaged in exploration and production activities globally.

As India's largest power company, NTPC Limited holds a commanding 17% share of the country's total installed electricity generation capacity, playing a vital role in national energy security. The company's vision is to be the world's most prominent power company by actively fueling the growth and development of India. Its core mission is to offer reliable power and associated services economically and efficiently, pursuing environmentally friendly methods driven by innovation. The group is mainly engaged in the generation and sale of bulk power to State Power Utilities, and has expanded its operations into coal mining and power trading. Strategically, the company is focused on a cleaner energy future and is on track to achieve a committed renewable energy capacity of 60 GW by the year 2032. It demonstrates superior operational efficiency, with its coal stations operating at an average Plant Load Factor of 77.25%, well above the national average.

Bajaj Auto is the world’s third-largest manufacturer of motorcycles and the largest manufacturer of three-wheelers. Headquartered in Pune, it is the flagship company of the Bajaj Group. 

Bajaj Auto has solidified its leadership in the electric vehicle (EV) segment with the Chetak range and recently disrupted the market by launching the world’s first CNG-powered motorcycle. The company maintains a strong global footprint, exporting to over 70 countries and holding a significant stake in the Austrian sports bike maker KTM AG.

Coal India Limited (CIL) is India's largest coal producer, operating under the Ministry of Coal and celebrating five decades of ensuring the nation's energy security and progress. Its vision is to emerge as a global player in the primary energy sector, committed to providing energy security through environmentally and socially sustainable growth using best practices. The company's mission is to produce and market planned quantities of coal and its products efficiently and economically in an eco-friendly way, with attention to safety and quality. For business sustainability, the company is diversifying into new revenue streams such as critical minerals, renewable energy, coal gasification, pump storage systems, and thermal power. The company operates through ten wholly-owned Indian subsidiaries, managing 310 mines across eight states in India, featuring opencast, underground, and mixed mining formats. In fiscal year 2024-25, CIL achieved its highest-ever production volume of approximately 781.06 million tonnes, a record-breaking performance for the company.

Nestlé India Limited is a major player in the country's food business, manufacturing and marketing a wide array of products for consumers. Guided by its promise to enhance life's quality, the company is dedicated to unlocking the power of food for both today's consumers and for future generations. This commitment is fulfilled by over 8,600 employees who work with a singular purpose of serving consumers with products of unimpeachable quality. Its business portfolio includes Milk Products and Nutrition, Prepared Dishes and Cooking Aids, Powdered and Liquid Beverages, and Confectionery. The company employs a comprehensive RUrban strategy, focusing on infrastructure and technology to strengthen its distribution reach in India's smaller towns and villages. A key achievement is making India the second-largest market globally for its KITKAT brand, a significant climb from tenth position a decade ago.

Power Grid Corporation of India Limited is a leading transmission company globally and a 'Maharatna' Public Sector Enterprise of the Government of India. Its vision is to become a world-class, integrated, global transmission company with dominant leadership in emerging power markets, ensuring reliability, safety, and economy. A key part of its mission is to set superior standards in capital project management and operations for the industry. POWERGRID's primary role is to lead India's power transmission network, facilitating the nationwide transfer of electricity from generation sources to distribution centers. Beyond its core transmission operations, the company has diversified into telecommunications and consultancy services, thereby expanding its business portfolio and value proposition. The company achieved a transmission system availability of 99.85%, which is one of the highest rates recorded globally.

Bharat Electronics Limited is a Government of India Navratna PSU, playing a key role in providing advanced, technology-led solutions for both defence and civilian requirements. Its main vision is to be recognised as a world-class enterprise in the field of professional electronics by delivering innovative and high-value products. The company operates as a customer-focused, globally competitive firm in defence and other professional electronics, driven by quality, technology, and innovation. Its core business focuses on developing advanced electronic equipment, systems, and services for the Indian defence sector, including radars and weapon systems. It also diversifies its business by creating innovative products for civilian markets like Homeland Security, Smart City Solutions, and Cyber Security. In the financial year 2023-24, the company successfully executed customer orders worth ₹19,820 crore, demonstrating strong market performance and project delivery.
Hindustan Zinc Limited is India's largest and the world's second-largest zinc-lead miner, also producing silver.

Tata Steel Limited is a leading globally diversified integrated steel producer with a total capacity of 35 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) across its major operations. The company aspires to be the global steel industry's benchmark for both value creation for its customers and its role as a responsible corporate citizen worldwide. Following the vision of its founder Jamsetji Tata, the company strives to strengthen India’s industrial base by making effective use of its staff and materials. It is expanding capacities to meet rising steel demand while simultaneously making a decisive transition towards a future with lower emissions, guided by its responsible growth philosophy. The company is investing in state-of-the-art electric arc furnaces in India and the UK, and is pursuing its decarbonisation journey in the Netherlands. As part of its major growth plan, the company commissioned India's largest blast furnace in FY2024-25, expanding its Kalinganagar plant's capacity from 3 to 8 MTPA.

Adani Green Energy Limited stands as India's largest and most rapidly expanding independent power producer focused purely on renewable energy. Its vision is to be a world-class leader in businesses that enrich lives and contribute to building national infrastructure through sustainable value creation. The company's core mission is to address India's pressing needs for energy security and decarbonisation with major investments in clean energy generation. AGEL's primary business involves developing, owning, and operating large-scale, grid-connected solar, wind, and hybrid renewable power plants across the country. The company is also pioneering energy storage solutions, including hydro-pumped storage projects and large-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). The company is developing the world's largest single-location 30 GW renewable energy project in Khavda, setting a global benchmark in the sector.

Asian Paints Limited is India's premier paint and décor brand and is recognized as one of the top ten decorative coatings companies in the world. The company's core purpose is to beautify, preserve, and transform all spaces and objects, with the ultimate goal of bringing happiness to the world. Engaged in the business of colour, décor, design, and protection, the company is dedicated to making anything and everything both beautiful and long-lasting. The company has successfully expanded its presence within the home décor ecosystem to provide more comprehensive solutions for living spaces. The company aims to be an integrated home décor player by offering a complete one-stop solution for customers looking to create their dream homes. With its significant scale and heritage, Asian Paints stands as the number one paint company in India, a leader in the industry since 1942.

Shriram Finance Limited is one of India's leading Non-Banking Finance Companies (NBFCs), playing a vital role in transforming the nation's credit ecosystem since its founding in 1979. The company's vision is to become the most preferred financial services destination in the country, delivering a delightful customer experience through its empowered employees. A core part of its mission is to enable economic growth and empower millions of people by providing them with customized lending solutions. It offers a diverse range of products, including loans for commercial and passenger vehicles, construction equipment, and support for micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs). The business strategy is strongly focused on financial inclusion, aiming to support the unbanked and underserved segments of the population. This wide reach is achieved through a network of 3,220 branch offices, serving over 9.5 million customers across India.

Avenue Supermarts Limited operates the DMart supermarket chain, conceived by value investor Mr. Radhakishan Damani to focus on the value retail grocery segment. The company's vision is to continuously investigate, identify and make available new products and categories for the customer's everyday use at the best value. Its core mission is to be the lowest-priced retailer in its area of operation, fulfilling customers' needs by providing quality products at great value. The company follows a cluster-based expansion approach, focusing on deepening its penetration in areas where it is already present before expanding to newer regions. This business model thrives on the principle of 'doing more with less', focusing on bulk procurement and movement of goods to create value for shoppers. In fiscal year 2024-25, the company marked steady progress by adding 50 new stores, bringing its total nationwide count to 415 stores.

TVSM is the world's fourth-largest two-wheeler manufacturer, building on a decades-long legacy of offering aspirational products to make personal mobility safer and more sustainable. Its vision is to transform the quality of life of people across the world by providing mobility solutions that are exciting, responsible, sustainable, and safe. The company's mission is supported by an innovation-driven culture that thrives on relentless reflection and teamwork to achieve its goals. It manufactures a wide range of vehicles to serve a broad customer base, including mopeds, scooters, commuter bikes, and premium motorcycles. TVSM is strategically expanding its international presence by fortifying its EV offerings and strengthening its distribution network across the world. Through its extensive distribution network, the company has successfully established a robust global presence in over 80 countries.

Grasim Industries Limited stands as a leading diversified company in India and is a flagship entity of the Aditya Birla Group. 

It is the world’s largest producer of Viscose Staple Fibre (VSF) and India’s largest Chlor-Alkali producer.

It recently disrupted the paints market with Birla Opus brand.

Hindalco Industries, the metals flagship of the Aditya Birla Group, is a leading global company in aluminium and copper, with a business model covering everything from mining to downstream products. Its vision is to be a world-class metals company, excelling in its operations and creating value for its stakeholders while being global in size and reach. The company's mission is to relentlessly create superior shareholder value, profitably exceeding customer expectations and unleashing employee potential, while being a responsible corporate citizen. It operates one of Asia's largest single-location custom copper smelters and is a leading player in India's specialty alumina market. Through its subsidiary Novelis, it is the world's largest recycler of aluminium and a leading producer of flat-rolled aluminium products. The company registered a consolidated EBITDA of ₹25,728 crore on a turnover of ₹215,962 crore for the financial year 2023-24.

For nearly 18 years, InterGlobe Aviation, known as IndiGo, has been dedicated to connecting India, fostering social unity, mobility, and economic advancement for the nation. The company's vision is to be India's most preferred airline for domestic and international connectivity, thereby establishing itself as a leading airline on the global stage. Its core mission is to fuel India's progress by offering a unique model of affordable connections, on-time flights, and smooth service across India and the world. It has built its success on key customer promises: affordable fares, reliable on-time performance, and courteous, hassle-free service, which form the basis of its operations. Starting with a single aircraft in 2006, the airline has grown into a major player with a formidable fleet of 367 aircraft today. By the end of FY 2024, the airline established a presence in 121 destinations by adding 10 domestic and 7 international routes, including Jakarta and Nairobi.

Eicher Motors Limited is an Indian multinational automotive company that manufactures iconic motorcycles under the Royal Enfield brand and modern commercial vehicles. The company's approach is defined as 'Pure Motorcycling,' which focuses on filling a rider's life with real and authentic experiences. It delivered a spectacular performance in FY 2023-24, selling 9,12,003 motorcycles, which is its highest-ever overall sales volume.

DLF is India’s largest publicly listed real estate company, with a dominant presence across residential, commercial, and retail segments. Headquartered in Gurugram, the company is credited with developing much of the city's modern infrastructure.

DLF is capitalizing on an unprecedented surge in premium residential demand, evidenced by the multi-billion dollar success of its newest super-luxury projects.

With a rental portfolio consistently operating at high occupancy and a pipeline of new retail destinations in Goa and Delhi, DLF remains a core holding for institutional investors tracking India’s urban consumption and infrastructure growth.

With over 75 years of innovation, Wipro is a purpose-driven global technology services and consulting firm, helping businesses navigate a rapidly changing world. The company's vision is to be a trusted partner for its clients, guiding their transformation with consulting and AI-powered solutions to make them industry leaders. As part of its mission, the company commits to being a catalyst for building a just, equitable, humane, and sustainable society for all. It leverages a broad portfolio of services in consulting, design, engineering, and operations to solve the most complex digital transformation challenges for its clients. Its 'ai360' strategy focuses on using AI to improve its own functions, enhance client services, and reimagine business with AI-powered solutions. The firm employs more than 230,000 experts across six continents, providing solutions that enable customers, colleagues, and communities to prosper globally.

Torrent Pharma is one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India, holding dominant leadership in chronic therapeutic segments including Cardiovascular (CV), Central Nervous System (CNS), and Gastrointestinal (GI).

The company successfully completed the acquisition of a 48.8% stake in JB Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals, significantly strengthening its domestic market share and dermatology portfolio.

The company disrupted the metabolic segment by launching India’s first oral semaglutide (brands: Sembolic and Semalix) at highly competitive pricing.
Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) is a Maharatna PSU and India's largest integrated energy company, engaged in refining, pipeline transportation, and marketing of petroleum products.

Samvardhana Motherson International Limited (formerly Motherson Sumi Systems) is a global automotive component giant specializing in wiring harnesses, vision systems (mirrors), and modules/polymer products.

Solar Industries India Limited is one of the world’s foremost manufacturers and suppliers of industrial explosives, initiating systems, and advanced ammunition for various sectors. The company's vision is to become a global leader in industrial and military explosives, establishing itself as an innovative solution provider focused on safety, quality, and reliability. A key part of its mission is to deliver innovative technology and services, which it achieves through continuous investment in Research and Development. The company has expanded from providing explosives for mining applications to supplying ammunition for national security and is now increasing its presence in the space sector. It is strategically positioned to meet emerging global demands by continuously investing in automation, R&D, and specialised infrastructure to fulfil large, long-term contracts for global customers. With a worldwide presence in over 90 countries and more than 40 manufacturing facilities, the company has established a strong global footprint.

Tata Motors (CV) is India’s largest commercial vehicle manufacturer and a global leader in the trucks and buses segment. Post-demerger, it operates as a focused entity housing the entire domestic and international CV business, including small, light, medium, and heavy trucks, as well as buses and defense vehicles.

The company is spearheading the transition to zero-emission commercial mobility through its "Ace EV" and "Starbus EV" platforms.

Trent is one of India's leading players in the branded lifestyle space, owning and operating multiple brands that provide quality, affordability, and an improved customer experience to a diverse audience. The company's core vision is to touch the lives of people in various markets by offering a comprehensive portfolio of distinct fashion and lifestyle brands. Its fundamental mission is to build brands that are consistently fresh and responsible, with the goal of bringing joy to everyone who uses them. The company seeks to nurture, build, and grow brands of significant scale within the fashion and lifestyle industry, where all brands share a common customer-first purpose. Its strategic choices differentiate it, with an obsession for delivering fresh products, credible quality, and compelling value propositions defining its brand portfolio. Operating from over 1,000 large-format fashion stores, the company has successfully engaged with and catered to more than 100 million customers.

Hyundai Motor India is the one of the largest passenger vehicle (car) manufacturer in India and a critical export hub for Hyundai Motor Company globally.

The company is currently pivoting toward a "multi-path" powertrain strategy, integrating mass-market Electric Vehicles (EVs) and newly announced Hybrid SUVs into its portfolio

Adani Energy Solutions Limited is India’s largest integrated energy player, holding a leading position in the transmission and distribution business by delivering reliable and sustainable energy solutions. Its vision is to be a world-class leader in businesses that enrich lives and create sustainable value, contributing significantly to building the nation's infrastructure. The company's approach sets new industry benchmarks through scale, strategic capital deployment, and rapid execution, ensuring expansion remains responsible, sustainable, and inclusive. It operates across power transmission, distribution, and smart metering, and provides innovative energy solutions like Cooling as a Service to various facets of the energy domain. Adani Energy Solutions is driving India's shift to renewables by integrating green electrons at scale, aiming to increase its renewable power mix to 60% by 2027. The company has a strategic presence across 16 states, operating a 26,696 ckm transmission network and serving over 12 million consumers.

Tech Mahindra is a global technology consulting and digital solutions company, serving enterprises across industries as a specialist in digital transformation and business re-engineering. The company’s vision is to be an agile, customer-centric, and purpose-led organization delivering best-in-class technology-led business solutions for its stakeholders. Its core purpose is to drive positive change in the lives of communities, believing that it will only rise when it enables others to rise together. As digital changemakers, the firm is intensely focused on scaling AI outcomes, empowering enterprises to use AI not just as a technology but as a strategic growth driver. This strategy is built on four pillars: Transformation Delivered, Productivity Delivered, Innovation Delivered, and Assurance Delivered, aiming to unlock real-world value for clients. With a team of over 148,000 professionals, the company crafts innovative solutions and intelligent digital experiences for its 1,100+ clients across more than 90 countries.

As one of India's most trusted private life insurers, SBI Life serves millions of families across the nation by securing the needs and aspirations of their loved ones. Aligning with the 'Insurance for All by 2047' mission, the company is working towards enabling every Indian citizen to have affordable and innovative life insurance solutions. Its purpose is to liberate individuals to pursue their dreams by securing the needs and aspirations of their loved ones. The company offers a diverse range of protection, savings, pension, and annuity products to both individual and group customers through traditional and unit-linked plans. With a strong and unrivalled distribution network among private insurers, it provides a wide range of products in uninsured and unserved market segments in India. For the financial year 2024, the company recorded a stellar 29% growth in New Business Premium, outperforming the industry's growth of 2%.

Union Bank of India stands as a key public sector institution, distinguishing itself through strong financial performance and a commitment to inclusive and responsible banking. Its vision is aligned with national priorities, aiming to act as a catalyst for India's economic progress by actively financing infrastructure, MSMEs, and green energy. The bank's mission is to maximize value for its investors and society by focusing on sustainable business growth, guided by strong corporate governance. Digitalization is at the core of its growth aspirations, leveraging the VYOM app and other digital innovations to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency. It champions inclusive growth by empowering women entrepreneurs through dedicated 'Nari Shakti' branches and providing extensive support to MSMEs across the country. The bank is strongly positioned with a capital adequacy of 18.02%, one of the best in the industry, ensuring ample room for future growth.
ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited is one of the largest asset management companies in India, managing mutual funds.
Jio Financial Services Limited provides financial services including lending, payments, and insurance broking.
Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited (Chola) is a diversified financial services company, offering vehicle finance, home loans, and SME loans.

Pidilite is India’s undisputed leader in adhesives and sealants, consumer chemicals, and construction chemicals. It is home to iconic brands like Fevicol, Dr. Fixit, M-Seal, and Fevikwik. 

Headquartered in Mumbai, the company operates 28 manufacturing plants in India and has a strong global presence through subsidiaries in the US, Thailand, UAE, and Brazil.

For over 130 years, Punjab National Bank has played a vital role in building the nation by giving loans to all parts of the Indian economy. The bank is dedicated to supporting India's vision of becoming a developed nation with a $30 trillion economy by the year 2047. It aims to drive growth by promoting financial inclusion, empowering citizens, supporting education, enhancing farmer's income, and encouraging new businesses through its innovative products. The bank has designated 1,000 branches for agriculture and another 1,000 for small and medium enterprises to deliver credit to these crucial sectors. Investing in advanced technology to provide seamless, secure, and convenient banking experiences across all its channels remains its highest priority. As of March 31, 2025, the Bank's total business grew to ₹26.83 Lakh Crore, a significant increase from the previous year.
Tata Capital Limited is the financial services arm of the Tata Group, offering a wide range of loans, investment, and wealth management products.

A subsidiary of the Swiss-Swedish multinational ABB Ltd, ABB India is a leader in electrification and automation. It operates through four business areas: Electrification, Motion, Process Automation, and Robotics & Discrete Automation.

It is currently riding the industrial capex wave, specifically in Data Centres, which now account for approx. 11% of its massive order book.

Billionbrains Garage Ventures Limited, operates under the flagship brand Groww and has evolved into a comprehensive wealth management platform.

The company’s ecosystem has expanded from a simple mutual fund interface into a professional grade financial hub offering stocks, ETFs, and advanced derivatives (equity and commodities). A key growth driver is its Margin Trading Facility (MTF), which provides significant leverage to traders.

Beyond Broking, Groww has strategically diversified its business through Groww Credit (retail lending), Groww Asset Management Company, and Wealth Management Vertical, "W" which offers high-net-worth individuals (HNIs) with sophisticated investment vehicles, including Portfolio Management Services (PMS) and Alternative Investment Funds (AIF).

Established in 1964, Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited is a major public sector company involved in making capital goods for India's core sectors like power and industry. Its main vision is to become a worldwide engineering enterprise that delivers effective solutions to build a better future for society and the environment. To achieve this, its mission focuses on providing sustainable business solutions in the important fields of Energy, Industry, and Infrastructure development. The company offers complete solutions, including products and services, for power generation from sources like thermal, hydro, nuclear, and solar, as well as for transmission and transportation. It expands its product portfolio through partnerships with global companies and through its own in-house product development, supported by consistent R&D investment. To serve both domestic and international customers, the company has set up 16 manufacturing plants that are strategically spread across various locations in India.

Varun Beverages is the flagship company of the RJ Corp Group and one of the largest franchisees of PepsiCo in the world (outside the USA). 

It produces and distributes a wide range of carbonated soft drinks (CSDs) and non-carbonated beverages (NCBs), including brands like Pepsi, Mountain Dew, Sting, Seven-Up, and Aquafina.

Bosch is a global technology and services company operating across four key sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. The company's ambition is to improve people's quality of life and safeguard the livelihoods of present and future generations by acting in a responsible manner. Its activities are guided by the principle 'Invented for life', developing intuitive and resource-efficient technologies to enhance convenience and safety. As an integral part of the global group, Bosch India plays a key role in driving innovation and delivering integrated technology solutions across various sectors. A key strategic priority is to shape change by seizing opportunities in connectivity, electrification, automation, and emerging markets. Reflecting its commitment to local value chains, its localization rate stands at 91% for conventional businesses and 53% for new-generation products.

Bank of Baroda is a venerable Indian financial institution with a rich history spanning over 116 years, dedicated to serving all its stakeholders with a stellar record of service. The bank's vision is to build a future-ready, world-class banking institution that consistently creates value for all its stakeholders through its commitment to core values and compliance. A core part of its mission is financial inclusion, treating it as a social commitment to provide universal banking services to all sections of society at an affordable cost. Operationally, the bank is committed to digitization and continuously strives to migrate transactions to digital channels, aiming to provide a superior customer experience through modern banking solutions. Its growth strategy involves a calibrated approach, focusing on high-yielding retail loans while aligning advances growth with deposit mobilisation to ensure balanced and profitable expansion. This strategy has proven effective, with the retail loan portfolio crossing the ₹2 lakh crore mark in FY2024, demonstrating a robust growth of 20.7% in this segment.

Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) is a Maharatna energy giant and a cornerstone of India’s petroleum sector. As the nation’s second-largest oil marketing company, it operates an extensive downstream network of over 21,000 fuel stations and 6,200 LPG distributorships.
Vodafone Idea Limited (Vi) is a leading telecommunications service provider in India, offering voice and data services across 2G, 3G, and 4G platforms.
Lenskart Solutions Private Limited is India's leading eyewear retail chain, offering a wide range of eyeglasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses through its online platform and physical stores.
Hitachi Energy India Limited provides power technologies and energy solutions, including grid automation and high voltage products.

Siemens Limited is a premier technology company with a comprehensive product portfolio, holding a leadership position across India's key sectors of industry, infrastructure, mobility, and energy. Its guiding mission is to create technology that transforms the everyday for everyone by developing innovations that resonate across communities and industries, creating meaningful change. A core part of its strategy is Siemens Xcelerator, an open digital business platform with a portfolio of IoT-enabled offerings to help customers digitalize and optimize operations. The Digital Industries business offers automation technologies, while Smart Infrastructure merges real and digital worlds for grids, buildings, and industrial facilities, improving efficiency and sustainability. Over 90 percent of its business enables customers to achieve a positive sustainability impact through decarbonization, energy efficiency, and enhanced resource circularity. The company's strong financial performance is highlighted by its Profit after Tax increasing by 39.4 percent to ₹26,651 million for the year.

Indian Bank operates with the vision of delivering excellence in financial services by focusing on customer needs, employee engagement, and sustainable growth. A core part of its mission is to incorporate the best of innovation and technology into its offerings to serve its customers effectively. The bank is also dedicated to creating value for its stakeholders and empowering its employees to drive its continued success. Its growth is significantly driven by a strategic focus on the Retail, Agriculture, and MSME sectors, which make up over 64% of its domestic loan portfolio. Embracing digital transformation, 95 percent of the bank's new savings accounts are opened digitally, with 92 percent of all transactions conducted through digital platforms. Showcasing strong financial performance, the bank's global business has surpassed ₹13 lakh crore, and for the first time, its net profit crossed the ₹10,000 crore milestone.

Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company registered with the RBI, primarily functioning as a holding and investment entity without its own direct operations. Guided by the vision of its founder, the Bajaj Group believes the true measure of success lies in the positive impact it has on people's lives. As an investment holding company, it seeks to reward shareholders by distributing a large part of the dividends it receives from its associate companies while participating in their value creation. The company's investment portfolio primarily consists of strategic investments in group companies and financial investments in capital markets. It holds significant strategic stakes in its main group companies, including 36.68% in Bajaj Auto Ltd. and 41.56% in Bajaj Finserv Ltd. The performance of its holdings is strong, with its associate Bajaj Auto Ltd. recording a remarkable 132% return during FY2024.
Laurus Labs Limited is a leading pharmaceutical company manufacturing Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) for anti-retroviral, oncology, and other therapeutic areas.
LTIMindtree Limited is a global technology consulting and digital solutions company, formed by the merger of L&T Infotech and Mindtree.

CG Power and Industrial Solutions is an established engineering leader in the electrical industry, creating products for railways, industrial sectors, and consumer appliances. The company's strategy is to anticipate future needs and align its current actions with a clear sense of direction to remain future-ready. With an 87-year legacy, the company now operates 18 world-class manufacturing units across India and Europe.

The Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL), India's largest hospitality company, has been an industry pioneer in South Asia for over 120 years with a diversified brand portfolio. Its vision is to become the most valued, responsible, and profitable hospitality eco-system in the region, which guides its commitment to realising India's full tourism potential. The company achieves this by offering a fusion of warm Indian hospitality and world-class service, a principle deeply rooted in its 'Tajness' philosophy of customer-centricity. IHCL operates a wide range of hotel brands catering to different market segments, from the iconic luxury of Taj to the revolutionary 'lean luxe' concept of Ginger. Under its 'Accelerate 2030' strategy, the company is focused on scaling its new and reimagined businesses to contribute over 25% of the total revenue by 2030. A key strategic objective is to more than double its hotel portfolio from 381 to over 700 hotels by the year 2030, significantly expanding its market footprint.

Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited is a global healthcare pioneer and India’s premier multi-specialty hospital chain. Since establishing the country's first corporate hospital in 1983, the Chennai-based giant has evolved into a comprehensive healthcare ecosystem.

Marico Limited is one of India's leading consumer goods companies that operates in the global beauty and wellness space, selling products in India and select markets across Asia and Africa. The company's long-term vision is to scale its business towards achieving ₹20,000 Crore in revenue by the year 2030, driven by innovation and purposeful brand building. A key operational principle is 'Bold Ambition,' where the company focuses on thinking big, starting small, learning from experiences, and then scaling up its successes quickly. It has cultivated a vibrant new-age digital-first portfolio of brands that is progressively increasing its contribution to the company's overall revenue and profit each year. The company has also steadily diversified its business, with revenue from its Foods and Premium Personal Care segments now standing at approximately 22% of its India business. Internationally, the company has expanded its footprint to over 25 countries across the emerging markets of Asia, Africa, and the Middle East.

As a Maharatna Public Sector Undertaking, GAIL is India’s leading natural gas company, managing a vast network of approximately 16,243 km of pipelines across the country. Its vision is to be a global leader in the natural gas value chain and beyond, creating value for stakeholders with strong environmental responsibility. The company strives to transform the lives of the people it touches by providing improved and environment-friendly products and services in a sustainable way. Its primary business activity is the marketing of natural gas and biofuels, which contributes to over 82% of the company's total turnover. The company is also a significant player in petrochemicals, with a polymer production capacity of 810 Kilo-Tonnes per annum at its Pata complex. Along with its group of companies, GAIL is also India's largest City Gas Distribution (CGD) operator, showcasing its strong focus on retail gas business.

HDFC Life Insurance Company Limited is a publicly listed life insurance provider in India, promoted by the country's leading private sector bank, HDFC Bank Limited. The company's vision is to be the most successful and admired Life Insurance Company, making it the most obvious choice for all its customers. Its steadfast purpose is to protect every Indian household and help individuals live with dignity, self-respect, and a deep sense of security. It caters to diverse customer needs through a range of individual and group products covering protection, pension, savings, investment, annuity and health. The company remains steadfast in its commitment to securing the future by bridging the insurance gap and driving long-term sustainable growth amid a rapidly evolving landscape. The company's market share expanded by 70 basis points to an all-time high of 11.1% in the overall sector.

Polycab India is India's largest integrated manufacturer of wires and cables and a prominent player in the fast-moving electrical goods industry. The company's core vision is to connect people to a brighter future through dependable solutions and forward-thinking innovation. It operates with a deep belief in its people and an obsession for serving customers to create delightful experiences. It manufactures and sells a wide range of wires and cables for both household and industrial use, serving a diverse customer base. Its FMEG business is a high-growth segment with a growing product mix that caters to a wide spectrum of customers. Polycab is the market leader, holding a 26-27% share of the domestic organised Wires & Cables market.
Canara Bank is one of India's largest public sector banks, providing a wide range of banking and financial services.

Zydus Lifesciences is a global, innovation-focused company that pioneers scientific research and technological advancements, always keeping patients at the heart of its work. The company's vision is to be a leading global life-sciences company, transforming lives through pathbreaking discoveries that improve health and well-being. Its mission is to unlock new possibilities in life-sciences by providing high-quality healthcare solutions that positively impact people's lives across the world. Zydus provides life-changing therapies that address unmet medical needs through disease prevention, early detection, and effective management, enhancing quality of life. The company ensures its products meet the highest global standards for quality and compliance, delivering safety and effectiveness to patients everywhere. In the competitive US market, the company is ranked among the top three players in over 55% of its marketed product families.

Reliance Industries Limited is a Fortune Global 500 company and the largest private sector company in India. The company's growth mirrors the relentless spirit of dynamism and hope that defines the nation, with its core motto being 'Growth is Life'. Its mission is to be the most admired, innovative, and value-generating organisation for all its stakeholders, operating through growth engines like retail and digital services. As the country's foremost retailer, it operates an integrated network of stores and digital commerce platforms, and as a premier digital provider, it caters to over 480 million subscribers. The company is also a global leader in Oil to Chemicals and a major player in India's Exploration and Production sector, with an upstream portfolio of gas fields. Crucially, its KG-D6 block operations now account for approximately 30% of India's domestic gas production, significantly enhancing the nation's energy security.
